newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends lower in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends lower in range-bound trade.

text.p: The Philippine peso closed slightly weaker at 26.340 to the dollar from Monday's 26.337 in listless trade, traders said.
"Today's market is very uneventful," one trader said. The peso just vacillated between 26.330 and 26.340. Turnover was at a meagre $134.5 million against $174.60 million on Monday.
He said banks were just buying dollars to cover the demand of their corporate clients.
"Nobody wants to take an aggressive position," another trader said.

The Central Bank raised its buying rate to 26.345 from 26.340, but banks did not take the cue because the system was long on dollars due to the influx of foreign funds into the equities market, he added.
The parallel market was quiet with done rates hovering slightly over the market rate.
The weighted average rate slipped fractionally to 26.335 from 26.333. - RAMONCITO DELA CRUZ 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
